description: Golden evaluation set for NL->SQL over the NYC TLC yellow taxi schema. Each case pairs a natural-language question with hand-written reference SQL. Accuracy is measured by comparing the result set of the generated query against the result set of the reference query (execution accuracy), not by string-matching the SQL - there are many correct ways to write each of these.

cases.question: How many trips were taken in total?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_trips FROM taxi

cases.question: How many trips had more than one passenger?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS trips FROM taxi WHERE passenger_count > 1

cases.question: How many distinct pickup zones are there?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PULocationID) AS zones FROM taxi

cases.question: How many trips were paid for in cash?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cash_trips FROM taxi WHERE payment_type = 2

cases.question: What is the average fare amount?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(fare_amount), 2) AS avg_fare FROM taxi

cases.question: What is the total revenue from all trips?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS total_revenue FROM taxi

cases.question: What is the longest trip distance recorded?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT MAX(trip_distance) AS max_distance FROM taxi

cases.question: What is the median fare amount?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT MEDIAN(fare_amount) AS median_fare FROM taxi

cases.question: What is the average tip amount on credit card trips?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(tip_amount), 2) AS avg_tip FROM taxi WHERE payment_type = 1

cases.question: What is the average trip duration in minutes?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(date_diff('minute', tpep_pickup_datetime, tpep_dropoff_datetime)), 2) AS avg_minutes FROM taxi

cases.question: What is the 95th percentile of fare amount?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT QUANTILE_CONT(fare_amount, 0.95) AS p95_fare FROM taxi

cases.question: What is the average trip distance by payment type?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT payment_type, ROUND(AVG(trip_distance), 2) AS avg_distance FROM taxi GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY payment_type

cases.question: How many trips were there per vendor?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT VendorID, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM taxi GROUP BY VendorID ORDER BY VendorID

cases.question: What is the average total amount by passenger count?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT passenger_count, ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) AS avg_total FROM taxi GROUP BY passenger_count ORDER BY passenger_count

cases.question: How many trips per rate code?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT RatecodeID, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM taxi GROUP BY RatecodeID ORDER BY RatecodeID

cases.question: How many trips were there in each month?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT MONTH(tpep_pickup_datetime) AS month, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM taxi GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

cases.question: How many pickups happen in each hour of the day?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT HOUR(tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM taxi GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour

cases.question: What hour of the day has the most pickups?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT HOUR(tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM taxi GROUP BY hour ORDER BY trips DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Which month had the most trips?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT MONTH(tpep_pickup_datetime) AS month, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM taxi GROUP BY month ORDER BY trips DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What is the average fare by day of week?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT DAYOFWEEK(tpep_pickup_datetime) AS day_of_week, ROUND(AVG(fare_amount), 2) AS avg_fare FROM taxi GROUP BY day_of_week ORDER BY day_of_week

cases.question: How many trips started between 6am and 10am?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS morning_trips FROM taxi WHERE HOUR(tpep_pickup_datetime) >= 6 AND HOUR(tpep_pickup_datetime) < 10

cases.question: What are the top 5 pickup locations by number of trips?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT PULocationID, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM taxi GROUP BY PULocationID ORDER BY trips DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: Which dropoff location has the highest average fare?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT DOLocationID, ROUND(AVG(fare_amount), 2) AS avg_fare FROM taxi GROUP BY DOLocationID ORDER BY avg_fare DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What are the 10 busiest pickup and dropoff location pairs?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT PULocationID, DOLocationID, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM taxi GROUP BY PULocationID, DOLocationID ORDER BY trips DESC LIMIT 10

cases.question: What percentage of trips are paid by credit card?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN payment_type = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_credit_card FROM taxi

cases.question: What is the average tip as a percentage of the fare?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(tip_amount) / SUM(fare_amount), 2) AS tip_pct FROM taxi WHERE fare_amount > 0

cases.question: What share of total revenue comes from tips?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(tip_amount) / SUM(total_amount), 2) AS tip_share FROM taxi

cases.question: What is the average fare for trips longer than 10 miles?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(fare_amount), 2) AS avg_fare FROM taxi WHERE trip_distance > 10

cases.question: How many trips had no tip?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS no_tip_trips FROM taxi WHERE tip_amount = 0

cases.question: How many trips had a congestion surcharge applied?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS surcharged_trips FROM taxi WHERE congestion_surcharge > 0

cases.question: What is the total amount collected in tolls?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(tolls_amount), 2) AS total_tolls FROM taxi

cases.question: For credit card trips, what is the average tip by passenger count?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT passenger_count, ROUND(AVG(tip_amount), 2) AS avg_tip FROM taxi WHERE payment_type = 1 GROUP BY passenger_count ORDER BY passenger_count

cases.question: What is the average fare per mile?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(fare_amount) / SUM(trip_distance), 2) AS fare_per_mile FROM taxi WHERE trip_distance > 0

cases.question: How many trips per hour on average during each month?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT MONTH(tpep_pickup_datetime) AS month, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT date_trunc('hour', tpep_pickup_datetime)), 2) AS avg_trips_per_hour FROM taxi GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

cases.question: Compare the average total amount for cash versus credit card trips
cases.reference_sql: SELECT payment_type, ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) AS avg_total FROM taxi WHERE payment_type IN (1, 2) GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY payment_type

cases.question: What is the average speed in miles per hour?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(trip_distance / (date_diff('second', tpep_pickup_datetime, tpep_dropoff_datetime) / 3600.0)), 2) AS avg_mph FROM taxi WHERE date_diff('second', tpep_pickup_datetime, tpep_dropoff_datetime) > 0 AND trip_distance > 0
